g.title: inputs
g.text: CI/CD deploy & release diffs • API gateway logs
HAR / browser journeys • frontend bundles • DNS / asset inventory

g.title: change
g.text: Normalize • correlate • deduplicate • identify changed services, routes and journeys

g.title: inventory
g.text: Discovered routes vs. 30–90 day traffic / docs
Active • Zombie candidate • Shadow candidate • Unknown

g.title: secgraph
g.text: Journey states • invariants • deployments • evidence provenance

g.title: planner
g.text: Changed routes → affected journeys → applicable invariants
LLM emits typed hypotheses and registered test adapters

g.title: policy
g.text: Exact scope • route/method policy • fixture/role checks • request budgets
Credential broker • health circuit breaker • audit-before-send • human approval policy

g.title: sandbox
g.text: Synthetic tenants / records • mock inventory • mock payment provider
Bounded workers • fixture reset • no production transactions

g.title: verifier
g.text: Clean fixture • minimal reproduction • system-of-record check
Negative control • evidence redaction • repeatability assessment

g.title: triage
g.text: Deduplicate • technical severity • tenant / PII / financial / inventory impact
Map owner with evidence; uncertain ownership goes to review

g.title: human
g.text: Inconclusive evidence or disputed severity / ownership

g.title: report
g.text: Invariant • reproduction recipe • redacted evidence • impact

g.title: retest
g.text: Fix / deploy event → rerun stored proof on a clean fixture
Close only when invariant is restored; otherwise reopen

g.title: baseline
g.text: Store release, route-map and regression result
